metaTitle: Custom Steel Phone Wallets | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom steel phone wallets for your team. Durable, sleek, and perfect for bulk branding at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Steel phone wallets offer a rugged, premium alternative to plastic or fabric options. The metal construction protects cards from bending while adding a professional weight that signals quality. Ideal for safety managers equipping field crews or marketing directors distributing durable giveaways at trade shows, these wallets accept laser engraving for a crisp, permanent logo. Choose from brushed or polished finishes to match your brand aesthetic.
heroAltText: Custom steel phone wallets with laser-engraved logo, brushed metal finish, slim design for credit cards
